rules.notes: HP er altid max. Class skill: 1 point pr. rank, max level+3. Cross-class: 2 point pr. rank, max (level+3)/2. Skills med crossTrainable=false kan kun tages som class skill. Epic: +1 BAB ved 21, 23, 25, 27, 29. +1 alle saves ved 22, 24, 26, 28, 30. Gifts: race bestemmer antal major/minor (ECL-tabel på wiki). En minor kan tages i stedet for en major. Major = ECL ≥ 1 (antagelse – wikiens fed-markering kunne ikke læses).

feats.name: Bane of Enemies
feats.description: Any weapon the character wields against any of their favored enemies is treated as a bane weapon for that creature type (+2 to hit and an additional +2d6 damage).

feats.name: Barbarian Rage
feats.description: The barbarian may rage, gaining a +4 morale bonus to strength and constitution and +2 to all will saving throws, in exchange for a -2 penalty to armor class. The barbarian may use this ability once per day at first level, +1 use per day at level 4, and every 4 levels thereafter, extending into epic levels. At 15th level, the rage ability becomes greater rage, giving the barbarian +6 to strength and constitution and +3 to will saves (the -2 penalty to armor class still applies).

feats.name: Bard Song
feats.description: Bards are able to sing a song that can bolster their allies. Deafened creatures are not affected by the bard's singing. The song affects all allies within 30 feet and lasts for 10 rounds. The higher the bard's final perform skill and class level, the better the bard song.

feats.name: Blindfight
feats.description: This feat grants the character the ability to fight well, even if blinded or against invisible creatures. The character gets to re-roll its miss chance percentile one time to see if it actually hits. Furthermore, invisible creatures get no bonus to hit the character in melee.

feats.name: Blinding Speed
feats.description: The character is able to cast haste on himself once per day. The effect will last 10 rounds.
feats.arelith: Arelith: øjeblikkelig, 3 turns, ubegrænset brug med 8 turns cooldown.

feats.name: Brew Potion
feats.description: The character can create a potion of any spell of third level or lower that the character knows and that targets a single creature. Brewing a potion will cost a small amount of XP as well as some gold to cover the material cost. The cost for brewing a potion depends on the innate level of the spell as well as the caster level of the resulting potion. Some examples: * A potion of bless (1) will cost 50 gold and 2 XP. * A potion of prayer (5) will cost 750 gold and 30 XP.

feats.name: Bull's Strength
feats.description: Starting at second level, a blackguard may cast bull's strength.

feats.name: Called Shot
feats.description: Grants the ability to make a potentially disabling attack against an opponent's arms or legs. Called shots are made at a -4 penalty, and must overcome the target's discipline skill check. A successful called shot against the legs reduces the opponent's movement rate by 20% and gives them a -2 cumulative penalty to their dexterity. A successful called shot against the arms applies a cumulative -2 penalty to the creature's attack rolls.
feats.requiresText: base attack bonus of +1 or higher

feats.name: Circle Kick
feats.description: If the character succeeds in hitting an opponent with an unarmed attack, that character gets an additional free attack against another, nearby enemy. There is a maximum of one free attack per round.
feats.requiresText: base attack bonus +3, dexterity 15+, improved unarmed strike

feats.name: Cleave
feats.description: If the character kills an opponent, he gets a free attack against any opponent who is within melee weapon range.

feats.name: Combat Casting
feats.description: The character is adept at casting spells in combat, and does not suffer the standard -4 penalty to concentration checks when casting defensively within four meters of an enemy.

feats.name: Craft Wand
feats.description: The spellcaster can create a wand of any spell of fourth level or lower that he knows. Crafting a wand costs a small amount of XP and gold, depending on the level of the spell to be crafted into the wand. A newly created wand has 1d20 + 1 charge per level of the caster (up to a maximum of 50 charges). The cost for crafting a wand depends on the level of the spell as well as the level of the resulting wand. Some examples: * A wand of magic missile (5) will cost 3750 gold and 150 XP. * A wand of Melf's acid arrow (5) will cost 7500 gold and 300 XP. * A wand of fireball (5) will cost 11250 gold and 450 XP.

feats.name: Create Undead

feats.name: Crippling Strike

feats.name: Defensive Awareness I

(2): The character can no longer be flanked, since he can react to opponents on opposite sides of him as easily as he can react to a single attack. (3): The character gains an intuitive sense that alerts him to danger from traps, giving a +1 bonus to reflex saves made to avoid traps.

In this defensive stance, a defender gains phenomenal strength and durability, but he cannot move from the spot he is defending. He gains the following benefits: * +2 strength * +4 constitution * +2 resistance bonus on all saves * +4 dodge bonus on AC At first level, this ability can be used once per day. feats.description: Starting at second level, an assassin gains the ability to cast ghostly visage.

feats.description: At third level, a shifter may shift into various creature forms (minotaur, harpy, gargoyle) three times per day.

feats.name: Greater Wildshape III

feats.description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to search checks.

feats.name: Skill Affinity (Spot)
feats.description: This feat grants a +2 racial bonus to spot checks.

feats.name: Skill Focus
feats.description: A character with this feat is adept at a certain skill, gaining a +3 bonus on all checks with it.
feats.arelith: Arelith: +5 til skill (vanilla +3). Hide/Move Silently og Listen/Spot giver den anden gratis. Persuade hedder Leadership.

feats.name: Skilled
feats.description: The character receives 4 extra skill points at first level, plus 1 additional skill point at each following level.

feats.name: Sleep
feats.description: A Harper scout at second level is able to cast sleep once per day.

feats.name: Small Stature
feats.description: Gnomes and halflings are small creatures. As such, they gain bonuses to their attack rolls, armor class, and hide checks when dealing with larger creatures. Note: Because they are so small, they cannot use the following weapons: dire mace, two-bladed sword, double axe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, heavy flail, quarterstaff, scythe, and spear.

feats.name: Snake Blood
feats.description: The character gains a +1 reflex saving throw bonus. Also, any saving throws versus poison gain an additional +2 fortitude bonus.
feats.requiresText: Can only take this at first level.

feats.name: Sneak Attack, Blackguard
feats.description: Whenever the character makes a successful attack against an opponent who is flat-footed, cannot see them, or who is in combat with someone else, the character's blow delivers extra damage. This extra damage is +1d6 at fourth level and an additional +1d6 every three levels thereafter. This extra damage is not multiplied in the case of a critical hit.

feats.name: Spell Focus
feats.description: A character with this feat is adept in a certain school of magic, granting a +2 bonus to spell save DC for all spells cast from that school.

feats.name: Stealthy
feats.description: The character gains a +2 bonus on hide and move silently checks.

feats.name: Stonecunning
feats.description: This feat grants a +2 bonus on search checks made in interior areas.

feats.name: Strong Soul
feats.description: The character gains a +1 bonus to fortitude and will saving throws, as well as a +1 bonus to any saving throw versus death magic.
feats.requiresText: Can only take this feat at first level.

feats.name: Summon Greater Undead
feats.description: At ninth level, a pale master may summon a greater undead once per day as a spell-like ability. The pale master's level determines the type of undead summoned: * Level 9: mummy warrior * Level 10: spectre * Level 12: vampire rogue * Level 14: greater bodak * Level 16: ghoul king * Level 18: vampire mage * Level 20: skeleton blackguard * Level 22: lich * Level 24: lich lord * Level 26: alhoon * Level 28: alhoon elder * Level 30: lesser demilich

feats.name: Summon Mount
feats.description: Summons to the paladin a faithful, magical beast — a warhorse mount. The beast is more powerful as the paladin gets more powerful. Note: Horses and the ride skill are only used in the premium module "Neverwinter Nights - Wyvern Crown of Cormyr" and specific community-made modules.

feats.name: Summon Undead
feats.description: The pale master can summon an undead creature twice per day as a spell-like ability. The level of the pale master determines the type of undead that is summoned: * Level 4 and 5: ghoul * Level 6: shadow * Level 7: ghast * Level 8: wight * Level 9: wraith

feats.name: Superior Initiative
feats.description: The character gains a +8 bonus on initiative checks.

feats.name: Superior Weapon Focus
feats.description: The weapon master gains a +1 bonus to all attack rolls with their weapon of choice.

feats.name: Thug
feats.description: The character gains a +2 bonus on initiative checks and a +2 bonus on persuade checks.

feats.name: Tough As Bone
feats.description: The pale master becomes immune to stun, hold, and paralyzation.

feats.name: Trackless Step
feats.description: This feat grants a +4 competence bonus to hide and move silently checks when in wilderness areas.

feats.name: Tymora's Smile
feats.description: Once per day, the Harper or a target receives a +2 saving throw bonus on all saving throws for 5 turns.

feats.name: Undead Graft
feats.description: Two times per day a pale master may use their undead arm to paralyze foes. At level 8 this may be used three times per day.

feats.name: Undead Shape
feats.description: The character with this ability can transform into a selection of powerful undead creatures three times per day: risen lord, vampire, and spectre.

feats.name: Venom Immunity
feats.description: The druid is immune to all poisons.

feats.name: Weapon of Choice
feats.description: The weapon chosen to be a weapon of choice by a weapon master becomes the focus for all of their special abilities.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Druid)
feats.description: This feat allows the character to use the club, dagger, dart, quarterstaff, scimitar, sickle, sling, and spear. Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Elf)
feats.description: This feat allows the character to use the longsword, rapier, longbow, and shortbow. Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Exotic)
feats.description: This feat allows effective use of all exotic weapons. The exotic weapons list includes the bastard sword, dire mace, dwarven waraxe*, double axe, kama, katana, kukri, scythe, shuriken, whip*, and two-bladed sword. * exclusive to Hordes of the Underdark Normal: A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Martial)
feats.description: This feat allows effective use of all martial weapons. The martial weapons list includes the battleaxe, greataxe, greatsword, halberd, handaxe, heavy flail, light flail, light hammer, longbow, longsword, rapier, scimitar, shortsword, shortbow, throwing axe, trident, and warhammer. Normal: A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Monk)
feats.description: This feat allows effective use of club, dagger, handaxe, light crossbow, heavy crossbow, quarterstaff, shuriken, kama, and sling. Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Simple)
feats.description: This feat allows effective use of all simple weapons, including the club, dagger, mace, sickle, spear, morningstar, quarterstaff, light and heavy crossbows, dart, and sling. Normal: A character cannot equip weapons they are not proficient in.

feats.name: Weapon Proficiency (Wizard)
feats.description: This feat allows the character to use the club, dagger, light crossbow, heavy crossbow, and quarterstaff. Normal: A character cannot equip a weapon he is not proficient in.

feats.name: Craft Ammunition
feats.description: Arelith: én gang om dagen, med våbnet udstyret, laves ammunition der skalerer med level (Bronze 1–5 … Masterly Damask 26–30).
feats.requiresText: Weapon Focus i våbengruppen (bow, crossbow, sling eller thrown)
